name: Gabriela Otaviano
text: I’m so grateful for my lovely Snagging surveyor Wanessa from MF were an absolute lifesaver throughout the process of checking my new-build home. From start to finish, she was patient, thorough, and incredibly reassuring. She spotted things I never would’ve noticed on my own and explained everything in a clear, friendly way. Their attention to detail gave me real peace of mind, and her support made the whole experience feel so much easier. I honestly couldn’t have asked for better help. If you’re moving into a new build, do yourself a favor and get Snagged you’ll feel supported every step of the way.
